papers.title_en: Sparse All-Layer Connector for Domain Generalised Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Ruoyu Guo, Xin Kun Lin, Maurice Pagnucco, Yang Song
papers.evidence: 语义分割与基础模型融合
papers.tldr: 域泛化语义分割（DGSS）常融合多个基础模型，但现有方法默认只在深度对齐层做跨模型融合，忽略了不同预训练目标导致表示层级和域敏感度差异。本文提出稀疏全层连接器（SALC），让每层可访问另一模型的前序层，并自适应选择稀疏信息层。还引入候选丢弃正则，增强稀疏性与探索多样性。在四种模型组合和三种评估设置下，SALC泛化优于深度对齐融合，代码已开源。
papers.abstract_en: Domain generalised semantic segmentation (DGSS) has recently benefited from combining multiple foundation models, such as vision-language and vision foundation models, to leverage their diverse representations for generalisation. Existing multi-model approaches share a common design choice: cross-model fusion is restricted to depth-aligned layers, implicitly assuming that mutually beneficial information resides at the same depth across models. However, foundation models pretrained under different objectives may develop distinct representation hierarchies, making the optimality of depth-aligned fusion questionable. Moreover, we observe that the foundation models exhibit different depth-wise domain sensitivity. Motivated by these observations, we propose a Sparse All-Layer Connector (SALC) that enables each layer to access information from preceding layers of another model. As the number of accessible layers grows with depth, dense aggregation may hurt generalisation. SALC therefore learns to adaptively select a sparse subset of informative layers. We further introduce a candidate dropout regularisation that strengthens sparsity and encourages SALC to explore diverse layers, leading to more robust selection. Across four foundation model combinations and three DGSS evaluation settings, the proposed design demonstrates stronger generalisation than conventional depth-aligned fusion. The code is available at https://github.com/RuoyuGuo/SALC.

papers.title_en: Multimodal Fusion of RGB and Complementary Modalities for Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Hu Cao, Yifeng Cheng, Mu He, Mengyu Li, Yinlong Liu, Alois Knoll
papers.evidence: 融合RGB与深度等模态的多模态语义分割
papers.tldr: 多模态语义分割通过引入热成像、LiDAR等辅助模态提升RGB在弱光与运动模糊下的鲁棒性，但传感器特征不匹配导致融合不稳定。为此，本文提出双向极性感知跨模态融合模块BPCF，在捕获互补线索的同时增强特征对齐。在RGB-热、RGB-LiDAR等六种模态组合上评估，于MFNet、KITTI-360等八个公开数据集取得SOTA。该工作为多模态分割提供通用融合方案，代码与模型将开源。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal semantic segmentation adds an auxiliary sensing stream to RGB images (RGB-X), such as thermal, LiDAR, depth, event, polarization, or light field. This can improve robustness in poor lighting and under motion blur. But different sensors often produce features that do not match well, and fusion can become unstable. To alleviate these issues, we propose a bidirectional polarity-aware cross-modality fusion (BPCF) module that effectively captures complementary cues while enhancing feature alignment. We evaluate the framework on six modality pairings: RGB-Thermal, RGB-LiDAR, RGB-Depth, RGB-Event, RGB-Polarization, and RGB-Light Field. Our model achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on eight public datasets, including MFNet, KITTI-360, DELIVER, DDD17, DSEC, MCubeS, ZJU, and UrbanLF. The codes and trained models will be released upon acceptance.
